highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 refreshes Skia m150 with GPU and shader correctness fixes.
highlights_body: The servicing update prevents stale Ganesh readbacks, restores resolve-task dirty tracking, and fixes a SkSL RasterPipeline use-after-free.

bullets.detail: Refreshes the bundled engine with fixes for failed Ganesh flushes, stale texture readbacks, resolve-task dirty tracking, Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion, and a SkSL RasterPipeline code-generation use-after-free.

harfbuzz_summary: Co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2, advancing from 14.2.1.1 with no HarfBuzz-specific product changes in this scope.
